model.name: FGO-like Story Banner
model.blurb: A 1% SSR rate, with a 0.8% rate-up and a guarantee at 330 summons. An off-banner SSR does not guarantee the next one.
model.source: Based on Fate/Grand Order's published rates (1% SSR, 3% SR) and the 330-summon rate-up pity added in 2022. This model gives a single rate-up 80% of SSR hits.
notes: SSR drops at 1%. A single rate-up gets 80% of those drops: 0.8% featured and 0.2% off-banner.
An off-banner SSR does not guarantee that the next SSR will be the rate-up.
At 330 summons, the rate-up SSR is guaranteed. The SSR rate does not ramp before then.
The 11-pull is a shop bundle; the simulator still resolves it as 11 individual summons.

overview.summary: Fate/Grand Order is a story-focused mobile RPG in which players collect Servants and assemble teams for battles. Summoning mixes rare characters with featured banners, so players may chase a favourite from the story as well as a useful team member. This simplified example uses the documented 2022 guarantee shape and a fictional reward pool, rather than claiming to match every current banner.
overview.distinctive: A rare summon is not always the featured Servant. In this example, an off-banner rare result does not prepare a guaranteed featured result next time; the separate long summon cap provides that protection.
overview.strength: The design interpretation is that a recognisable franchise and extended character stories give collection goals meaning beyond raw combat strength. A late guarantee offers a final destination, while leaving a much longer possible chase than an early checkpoint system.
overview.analysis: Look at how many players receive the featured reward, how often rare pulls miss it, and how far the unlucky players have to go. Compare a long summon cap with stronger protection after an off-banner result.
overview.popularity: Sensor Tower estimated $4 billion in lifetime mobile player spending in January 2020 and ranked FGO as Japan's highest-grossing mobile game of 2019. The publisher marked 30 million downloads in October 2024. These dated indicators describe reach and spending, not a satisfaction score for the guarantee rule.
overview.business: Players can purchase summon currency to pursue featured Servants and extra copies. The design interpretation is that story attachment and banner availability create reasons to spend. Historical gross player spending does not reveal net profit, and this simulation does not reproduce live purchasing behaviour.
